info.title: Dayflow API
info.description: Work management platform — boards, items, collaboration.

signupToken.description: Token returned by otp/verify for a new user

selectToken.description: Token returned by otp/verify for an existing user

idToken.description: Google ID token from the native Google Sign-In SDK

workspaceId.description: Defaults to the oldest workspace in the account

template.description: Template key from GET /v1/templates (built-in or custom_…)

type.description: Changing visibility takes a board owner or an account admin

workspaceId.description: Defaults to the source board's workspace

includeItems.description: Snapshot the current items as sample rows

userId.description: An active member of this account

afterGroupId.description: Place after this group; null moves it first

afterItemId.description: Place after this item; null puts it first; omit to append

itemIds.description: Items on this board (top-level or subitems), 1..200

afterItemId.description: Place after this sibling; null puts it first; omit to append

groupId.description: Target group; omit to reorder within the current group (subitems: always omit)

afterItemId.description: Place after this item; null moves it first

value.description: Shape depends on the column type: {labelId} for status, {userIds:[]} for people, {date,time?} for date, {text} for text/long_text, {number} for number, {checked} for checkbox, {email,label?}, {phone,countryCode?}, {rating}, {fileIds:[]}, {url,label?}, {address,lat?,lng?}, {from,to} for timeline, {optionIds:[]} for dropdown/tags. Send null to clear the cell.

settings.description: Type-specific settings; sensible defaults are applied when omitted

afterColumnId.description: Place after this column (same scope); null moves it first

config.description: ViewConfig: filters, sort, hiddenColumnIds, columnOrder, conditionalColors, laneColumnId, dateColumnId

isDefault.description: true makes this the default view; false is rejected — pick another default instead

afterViewId.description: Place after this view; null moves it first
